  "screen_rationale": "The study performs a systematic review comparing treatment effects in animal models to clinical trials for six interventions, explicitly calculating and discussing concordance rates and effect sizes. It quantifies agreement between animal and human outcomes.",

    "neurology-stroke",

  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study reviews six different interventions, each with its own set of animal models (e.g., animal models of traumatic head injury, animal models of acute ischaemic stroke, animal models of preterm delivery, animal models of osteoporosis).",

    "non-human-primate"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The study mentions experiments in monkeys, cattle, rabbits, baboons, and rats. It also refers to 'animal models' generally and pooled results for 'all animals combined'.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study reports on mortality, functional outcomes (e.g., grip test, neurobehavioural scores), infarct volume, and bone mineral density, which represent both hard and biomarker endpoints."
